d:
Mukesh Ambani became emotional during the Jio Platforms listing ceremony at the NSE on October 28, 2026.
His son Anant Ambani spoke about Jio’s journey, family legacy and the millions of Indians who helped make Jio what it is today.
Anant said that for him, “business is pooja” and compared the exchange bell to a temple bell. Isha Ambani also recalled Mukesh Ambani’s early days at Reliance and his work on the company’s first public offering in 1977.
Jio Platforms made a strong stock market debut, listing at ₹1,359, around 21.4% above its IPO price of ₹1,119.
